description: This Python source file implements the configuration and transformation logic for the Anthropic Skills API within the litellm project. It defines a class that manages API requests and responses, transforming data to and from the formats expected by the API and the internal models.

classes.name: AnthropicSkillsConfig
classes.description: A configuration class for Anthropic's Skills API, providing methods to validate environment headers, construct URLs, and transform requests and responses specific to Anthropic's API.

methods.name: LlmProviders custom_llm_provider(self)
methods.description: Returns the provider enum indicating Anthropic as the LLM provider.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, litellm_params: Optional[GenericLiteLLMParams] )
methods.description: Adds required headers, including API key and version headers, validating that necessary environment variables are set.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], endpoint: str, skill_id: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Constructs the full API endpoint URL for Anthropic Skills API requests based on input parameters.

methods.name: Dict transform_create_skill_request( self, create_request: CreateSkillRequest, litellm_params: GenericLiteLLMParams, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Transforms a create skill request into the format expected by the Anthropic API.

methods.name: Skill transform_create_skill_response( self, raw_response: httpx.Response, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, )
methods.description: Converts the raw HTTP response from the create skill API call into a Skill object.

methods.name: Tuple[str,Dict] transform_list_skills_request( self, list_params: ListSkillsParams, litellm_params: GenericLiteLLMParams, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Prepares the URL and query parameters for listing skills via the Anthropic API.

methods.name: ListSkillsResponse transform_list_skills_response( self, raw_response: httpx.Response, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, )
methods.description: Transforms the list skills HTTP response into a ListSkillsResponse object.

methods.name: Tuple[str,Dict] transform_get_skill_request( self, skill_id: str, api_base: str, litellm_params: GenericLiteLLMParams, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Creates the URL and headers for a get skill API request.

methods.name: Skill transform_get_skill_response( self, raw_response: httpx.Response, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, )
methods.description: Transforms the get skill HTTP response into a Skill object.

methods.name: Tuple[str,Dict] transform_delete_skill_request( self, skill_id: str, api_base: str, litellm_params: GenericLiteLLMParams, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Creates the URL and headers for a delete skill API request.

methods.name: DeleteSkillResponse transform_delete_skill_response( self, raw_response: httpx.Response, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, )
methods.description: Transforms the delete skill HTTP response into a DeleteSkillResponse object.
